substitutions: the dataloader's host buffer is not pinned (there is no GPU)
the dataloader's batches stay on the CPU
evaluate_bpb's token byte table stays on the CPU
FlashAttention 3 needs a Hopper GPU; scaled_dot_product_attention with the same causal sliding-window mask (key j visible from query i when 0 <= i - j <= window) computes the same function
rotary tables stay float32 (Decision G: F32 until tensomite computes in BF16)
No torch.autocast: every operation runs in float32 on the CPU.

Weights that train.py initialises to zero (c_proj, mlp.c_proj, ve_gate) are drawn from uniform(-s/2, s/2), lm_head is drawn from normal(0, 1) so that logits reach the softcap's non-linear range, and resid_lambdas and x0_lambdas get per-layer noise, so that every gradient and every per-layer scalar is exercised.
